definitions: The superlative form of the adjective 'degenerate', meaning having lost the physical, mental, or moral qualities considered normal and desirable; showing evidence of decline.
Having undergone the greatest degree of deterioration or decline from a former or original state.
Exhibiting the highest level of moral or physical decay.
examples: The most degenerate form of the species was found in the polluted river.
Critics called it the most degenerate play of the season.
He was considered the most degenerate member of the royal family.
